- Payment terms: Procurement prefers Net 45; please let us know if Redwood can accept Net 30 or needs Net 45.
- We'd like to complete contracting in two weeks if possible; our legal lead is on cc.

Please confirm receipt and who on your side will own the intake/redline. If Redwood prefers to use a template MSA instead of the attached, point us to it and we can adjust.

Olga / Marcus — thanks, reviewing now. Quick intake notes: 
1) Data residency: Acme specifically called out US-only. Our Private deployment supports region locking, but hosted offering can be routed to US regions; need legal to confirm wording.
2) SLA 99.9%: For pilots we typically offer best-effort, but we can propose a time-bound SLA in Order Form (e.g., for production tier only). Recommend we push SLA to Order Form rather than core MSA, or offer a limited SLA with service credits capped.
3) Payment terms: Net 45 is doable at enterprise level if Finance has a contract; for pilot we prefer Net 30. Marcus — if this is revenue-impacting, I'll flag to Finance.
4) Key redline targets: liability cap, indemnity carveouts for third-party data, and IP ownership on model outputs.

Plan: I'll produce a marked-up MSA with tracked changes and a short intake checklist by EOD Monday. Marcus, can you confirm the expected token/month and whether this pilot requires additional compliance attestation (SOC2 evidence)?

-Kimberly

Thanks, Kimberly. A few clarifications from Procurement:
- Pilot expected usage: approx 500k tokens/month, spike to 1M for demo weeks — we put conservative numbers in the OrderForm.xlsx.
- Payment: Procurement prefers Net 45; PO will be raised for pilot value ~ $18k.
- Security: Acme has SOC2 Type II; for Redwood we'd need to see SOC2 report or equivalent; Acme is okay doing an NDA for evidence exchange.
- Data residency: yes, must be US-only for the pilot — our customers include regulated financial data.

We can accept an Order Form-level SLA or a time-limited pilot SLA; main thing is that the hosting region is US and that we have a clear remedy if availability drops below threshold.

Link to procurement folder and PO template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bAcmeContractFiles
DocuSign preference: Procurement will prefer DocuSign once final.

Jordan
